scope: Read-only C AST check on each recorded final definition. Every direct address of a restored local occurs as an immediate call argument, possibly through a cast; no direct pointer assignment, return or comma expression hides a later source consumer. Typedef names are syntactic parser stubs, not an ABI/type proof. The one unrelated EXE_FN macro has no address operands and is replaced with a parser-only call name. Callee internals and arbitrary pointer retention are not inferred.
